text: This report recommends names for 3 public lanes located in Ward 21 St. Paul's. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Charley Roach Lane" for the public lane north of St. Clair Avenue West, extending between Arlington Avenue and Rushton Road. 2. Approved the name "Don Francks Lane" for the public lane east of Bathurst Street, extending northerly from Tichester Road then easterly to Lonsmount Drive. 3. Approved the name "Nick Vitantonio Lane" for the public lane west of Spadina Road, extending between Lonsdale Road and Montclair Avenue.
